item.title: Brussels home damaged in early morning fire
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- An early Monday morning fire in the Town of Brussels is serving as a reminder for residents to properly dispose of ashes from wood-burning stoves.

item.title: El-Na Farms to host Kewaunee County Breakfast on the Farm again
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- If you missed last year's Kewaunee County Breakfast on the Farm at El-Na Farms in Algoma, you'll have another chance this summer.

item.title: Officials Urge Drivers to Give Snowplows Space After Multiple of Crashes
item.description: Adam Collins -- After a series of crashes involving snowplows across the state, Wisconsin transportation officials are reminding drivers to slow down and give plow operators room to work.

item.title: Door County comes together to support Warrior Violet
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- For the second time this season, the battle on the Sevastopol High School basketball court will take a back seat to a much more important fight off it.

item.title: Austin Straubel Airport to Receive $4 Million Federal Grant
item.description: Adam Collins -- Green Bay Austin Straubel International Airport is set to receive a significant federal investment aimed at improving safety and efficiency across its airfield.

item.title: Farmers focus on improvement, not settling, in conservation efforts
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Farmers in Door and Kewaunee counties are expected to employ even more conservation strategies after more than 90 farmers, agriculture professionals, and community members attended the Peninsula Pride Farms Annual Meeting on Tuesday at Lambeau Field.

item.title: City strikes deal for South 18th Avenue extension
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A roadway you have likely used to access destinations along Sturgeon Bay's east waterfront near the Bayview Bridge will soon be under city control.

item.title: New M² Mentorship Program Taking Shape in Door County
item.description: Adam Collins -- A new mentorship initiative launching in Door County aims to connect experienced professionals with emerging leaders, entrepreneurs, and lifelong learners across the community.

item.title: Wisconsin hunters harvest 17,000-plus more deer than previous year
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Door and Kewaunee counties followed the statewide trend in deer harvest numbers this season.

item.title: Fatal One-Vehicle Crash on Highway 57 in Sevastopol Under Investigation
item.description: Adam Collins -- A fatal one-vehicle crash claimed the life of a driver Friday night in the Town of Sevastopol, according to the Door County Sheriff's Office.
